summary: Franklin Resources filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of $750 million aggregate principal amount of 5.500% notes due 2036. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations, issued at 99.137% of par, with net proceeds of approximately $738.65 million. Interest is payable semi-annually, and the company may redeem the notes at any time. The offering is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. Joint book-running managers include BofA Securities, HSBC, and others. The notes will not be listed on any exchange.
